label: s2_side01_0110_gfather_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hello there, Kieran. And to you too,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: s2_side01_0110_brother_02
text: What’re you both doing here? Is Carmine OK?!\nAnd did you see a girl come by here?![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0110_gfather_02
text: Slow down, Kieran. One question at a time.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: s2_side01_0110_gfather_03
text: Carmine is at home, sleeping in her room. She\nmust’ve tuckered herself out with all that dancing.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: s2_side01_0110_gfather_04
text: We thought we’d step out while she slept to get\nsome of her favorite noodles from the stall here.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: s2_side01_0110_gfather_05
text: A taste of her favorite food might help snap her\nout of whatever is going on with her.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: s2_side01_0110_brother_04
text: Oh... Yeah, I hope so. Good thinking, Grandpa.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0110_gfather_06
text: Now, what was that you were asking about some\ngirl coming this way?[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: s2_side01_0110_brother_05
text: Oh! Right! Everyone in town is actin’ all weird.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0110_brother_06
text: And one of the girls who came here from Paldea\nwent missing![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0110_select_02
text: She’s really loud and full of energy!

label: s2_side01_0110_gfather_07
text: Well, now that you mention it, we did run into a\ngirl wearing a uniform not too long ago.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: s2_side01_0110_gfather_08
text: Well, now that you mention it, we did run into a\nrather boisterous stranger in the village earlier.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: s2_side01_0110_gfather_09
text: You spoke with her, dear. What did she say?[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: s2_side01_0110_gfather_11
text: Hm? I...I don’t need any mochi at the moment.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: s2_side01_0110_gfather_12
text: This is awfully sudden, dear. But I suppose if you\ninsist...[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: s2_side01_0110_gfather_14
text: All right, I’ve had some mochi, dear. Now can we\nget back to the question?[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: s2_side01_0110_brother_12
text: Gramps and Grandma too? Everyone’s losing it...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0110_brother_13
text: It’s just a matter of time until it gets me...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0110_brother_14
text: I’m gonna end up like all the rest of ’em![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0110_brother_17
text: OK, let’s think... Before Gramps started acting\nlike Carmine, he ate some of that weird mochi...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0110_friend_02
text: Yeah? Thank goodness. Just hearing your voice\nis helping me calm down.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0110_friend_03
text: We’re fine over here! Though Penny got herself\nall spooked and has been kind of a mess.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0110_friend_04
text: We got worried because we hadn’t heard from\nyou in a while, so we decided to step outside...\r\nand things are WEIRD out here, little buddy.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0110_friend_05
text: We were attacked by all these folks shouting\n“Mochi mochi!” at us, and we couldn’t spot you\r\nanywhere, so I was beginning to fear the worst![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0110_friend_06
text: We’re holding tight by that Peachy’s place for\nthe moment, but—[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0110_botan_01
text: Eek! Eyaaauuughhh! There’s something there!\nThere’s SOMETHING THERE, Arven![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0110_brother_18
text: What’s wrong?! Are you two OK?![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0110_friend_08
text: Oh crud, this does NOT look good![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0110_brother_21
text: Grandma, Grandpa...I’ll be back, so don’t go\nanywhere![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0110_brother_22
text: I still wanna find Nemona, but we gotta get to\nPeachy’s and check on Arven and Penny! C’mon![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
